reproduce: sh skill/tests/run_tests.sh     (offline: no board, no pynq, no network)

golden_compare.what: NPZ numerical comparator. Each case runs golden_compare.py on a real committed weight file (src/model/assets/w_attn4_p_emotion_v_f0.npz) and checks the exit code.

pynq_probe.what: Handoff parsing, register-map validation and word capture, checked against this repository's own artefacts.
not_verified: overlay.Board has never been executed on hardware in this form. The offline modules are tested; the board module is written against the PYNQ 3.x API and is unverified.
No case here proves that a passing register map means the loaded bitstream is the intended one. Only an identity-register match does that, and it is not tested offline.
